_comment: Vendored boundary config (mirrors harness vendor/loader/tsconfig.json relaxations; layout adapted — no harness tsconfig.base.json here). FULL EMIT into gitignored lib/ (lib/*.js + lib/types/*.d.ts, the harness lib/ layout): the harness sources are NOT strip-types-erasable (parameter properties), so the runtime loads the emitted JS while the gateway program consumes the declarations via tsconfig paths — the strict gateway program never typechecks these sources. Rebuild: plugins/gateway/scripts/link-vendored-platform.sh paths: single-identity rule (D2) — cordis resolves to this member's own node_modules copy (=== gateway-core's program copy, verified same store path) and the loader to its built lib/types, exactly the gateway-core program shape; without it the dsh-family registry graph splits same-version peer contexts and nominal Context/Fiber types diverge (TS2345/TS2339).
